headline: The Studio runs two builders now
lede: Jon steered #1258: the forge fleet grew to two builder slots plus QA on the Studio's model, every lane pulling from the whole queue — and the 48-hour trial grades and enforces itself.

notes.text: #1258 shipped: slot b boots by itself off main, the warden plans claims for both builders and studio QA from one pure ladder, and games-first ordering means queued titles get builders while QA sweeps feedback.
One lane per issue is now enforced at the moment of claiming: builder and QA claims share a single live namespace, newest wins, the loser yields — no more two lanes in one game.
The trial reports items/day before-vs-after on #1258 at the 48h mark and writes its own keep/revert verdict; revert quietly un-arms slot b. Gaps it shipped with are filed as #1266.
